batch.title: Tours and Artist delivery
batch.goal: Complete event-to-tour planning, publication, roster convergence, and Artist-visible itinerary delivery.
exitCriteria: Provider event to published tour to Artist-visible itinerary succeeds with canonical IDs and local-time correctness.
Autosave, duplicate, quarantine, holds, ghost-stop, idempotency, and recovery cases pass.

specTasks.title: Publication
acceptanceCriteria: What “published” means, whether publication is a snapshot, audience rules, acknowledgement, retraction, and correction behavior

specTasks.title: Readiness
acceptanceCriteria: Mandatory blockers versus warnings, including whether venue profiles and staffing are required before publication

specTasks.title: Approve stop/event identity ADR
acceptanceCriteria: Rules cover new event, existing event, shared event, non-show day, detach, cancellation, archive, delete, and settlement protection.

specTasks.title: Inventory route JSON/settings
acceptanceCriteria: Every current field has canonical destination, migration/default rule, compatibility read period, and retirement owner.

specTasks.title: Fix readiness contract decision
acceptanceCriteria: Product decides venue-profile and staffing requirements; UI/server/tests use the same blockers/warnings and explain remediation.

specTasks.title: Approve publication ADR
acceptanceCriteria: Defines snapshot immutability, types, readiness, overrides, audience evaluation, acknowledgement, corrections, retraction, and retention.

specTasks.title: Classify publishable fields
acceptanceCriteria: Every section/field has audience class such as internal, worker, department, vendor, public, financial, personnel, or sensitive traveler data.

specTasks.title: Define lifecycle state machine
acceptanceCriteria: States, transitions, required capabilities, blockers, side effects, cancellation/archive behavior, and invalid-transition errors are approved and tested.

specTasks.title: Build canonical tour access service
acceptanceCriteria: All panels resolve the same org/tour authority; collaborator and entity-grant behavior is consistent; legacy endpoints delegate to it.

specTasks.title: Inventory and classify legacy routes
acceptanceCriteria: Every `/api/tours/*` consumer has owner, replacement, data source, flag, and retirement milestone; no undocumented write path remains.

specTasks.title: Build portfolio query contract
acceptanceCriteria: Cursor pagination, filter grammar, sort allowlist, stable counts, search normalization, and authorization are contract-tested on representative scale.

specTasks.title: Add explicit error/degraded states
acceptanceCriteria: Portfolio and command-center tabs distinguish permission, unavailable dependency, stale snapshot, no records, and system error with retry/correlation support.

specTasks.title: Instrument tour access and latency
acceptanceCriteria: Metrics capture list/summary latency, denied/failed calls, stale read models, legacy-route usage, and client request fanout.

specTasks.title: Build canonical plan read/write service
acceptanceCriteria: Builder no longer writes route JSON and links independently; command validates org, capability, plan version, and full plan schema.

specTasks.title: Add optimistic plan version
acceptanceCriteria: Every mutation returns new version; stale edits return `409 version_conflict` with safe diff; autosave never silently overwrites.

specTasks.title: Add exact stop reconciliation
acceptanceCriteria: Submitted set supports add/update/reorder/detach; omitted links are handled according to explicit mode; event identity is retained unless separately eligible for deletion.

specTasks.title: Add reconciliation preview
acceptanceCriteria: UI displays exact relational and downstream consequences before destructive detach/reorder/date/venue changes.

specTasks.title: Remove implicit operational seeding
acceptanceCriteria: Builder records setup intent only; staff shifts/ticket inventory require explicit reviewed provisioning commands with visible results.

specTasks.title: Create outbox infrastructure
acceptanceCriteria: Domain transaction and outbox write are atomic; workers are idempotent; retry/backoff/dead letter/replay and correlation are implemented.

specTasks.title: Create publication schema
acceptanceCriteria: Snapshot, section, audience, recipient, delivery, acknowledgement, share token, access log, and outbox relations have org-scoped RLS.

specTasks.title: Build channel adapter contract
acceptanceCriteria: In-app is first-class; email/SMS/push adapters expose request, provider ID, delivery state, retryability, and cost/consent metadata.

specTasks.title: Implement version-aware metadata edits
acceptanceCriteria: expectedVersion` prevents silent overwrite; user sees conflicting fields and can reload or intentionally reapply changes.

specTasks.title: Implement transition commands
acceptanceCriteria: Status cannot be patched directly; commands enforce readiness/state/capability and write transaction + audit + outbox event.

specTasks.title: Build command-center summary BFF
acceptanceCriteria: One initial request returns identity, lifecycle, current/published versions, counts, risks, freshness, and domain access; p95 target is defined and measured.

specTasks.title: Split command-center route bundles
acceptanceCriteria: Tabs load independently with stable typed contracts; opening overview does not download every editor or trigger duplicate calls.

specTasks.title: Create deep-duplicate preview
acceptanceCriteria: User selects metadata, stops/events, team roles, vendors, templates, budgets, documents, logistics skeletons, and permissions; preview lists copies, links, exclusions, and conflicts.

specTasks.title: Execute idempotent duplication job
acceptanceCriteria: Large copies run as a resumable job, preserve source IDs in audit metadata, generate new tokens/identities, and report per-domain completion/failure.

specTasks.title: Implement archive/restore
acceptanceCriteria: Impact preview identifies shares/jobs/upcoming work; archive makes tour read-only, revokes eligible shares, and preserves legal/financial records.

specTasks.title: Implement safe draft deletion
acceptanceCriteria: Eligibility blocks deletion when published, ticketed, contracted, paid, staffed, or referenced; authorized deletion is transactional and audited.

specTasks.title: Add tags, owners, and organization saved views
acceptanceCriteria: Views store validated filters/columns, respect changing permissions, and cannot expose counts/names for unauthorized tours.

specTasks.title: Add bulk command preview/execution
acceptanceCriteria: Bulk operations show eligible/ineligible items before confirmation, require idempotency, and return item-level results without hiding partial failure.

specTasks.title: Create `tour_versions` and `tour_stops`
acceptanceCriteria: Backfill is deterministic; route/order data reconciles with `tour_events`; unresolved conflicts are quarantined and reviewed.

specTasks.title: Build stop editor
acceptanceCriteria: Supports all stop types, local time zone, windows, venue relation/free-text draft, contacts, notes, status, and validation without raw IDs.

specTasks.title: Build reorder/timeline interaction
acceptanceCriteria: Keyboard and pointer reorder update real ordinals; duplicate/missing ordinals are prevented by constraint/transaction and tested.

specTasks.title: Implement stop protection rules
acceptanceCriteria: Published, ticketed, contracted, staffed, or settled stops require impact workflow; errors list blocking records and authorized next action.

specTasks.title: Implement holds/options
acceptanceCriteria: Create/update/expire/confirm/release with reminders and history; competing holds and confirmation conversion are visible.

specTasks.title: Add server readiness engine
acceptanceCriteria: Rules consume persisted normalized data and return stable IDs, severity, scope, evidence, remediation URL, and override policy.

specTasks.title: Add change sets and diff
acceptanceCriteria: Post-publication edits generate categorized diffs and identify affected publications, people, bookings, schedules, tickets, vendors, and budgets.

specTasks.title: Add selectable deep-copy support
acceptanceCriteria: Planner exposes which stops/holds/templates/settings are copied, linked, or excluded and validates dates/time zones for shifted schedules.

specTasks.title: Enforce server readiness in publish command
acceptanceCriteria: Command reloads persisted plan, evaluates rules inside transaction, rejects blockers, records authorized warning overrides, and cannot be bypassed by command-center UI.

specTasks.title: Build snapshot renderer
acceptanceCriteria: Same source version always generates equivalent manifest/checksum; missing section fails or is explicitly excluded rather than silently omitted.

specTasks.title: Build audience preview
acceptanceCriteria: Recipient resolution shows count, role/source, excluded recipients and reason, protected fields, and channel availability before confirmation.

specTasks.title: Implement transactional publish
acceptanceCriteria: Snapshot, audience, deliveries, lifecycle transition, audit, and outbox commit together; duplicate idempotency key returns original publication.

specTasks.title: Implement delivery dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Managers see queued/delivered/opened/acknowledged/failed by channel/recipient, retry safe failures, and export authorized delivery evidence.

specTasks.title: Implement secure share links
acceptanceCriteria: Token is high entropy and hashed at rest; scope, expiry, optional passcode, download permission, max-use/revocation, and access logging are enforced.

specTasks.title: Implement retract/supersede
acceptanceCriteria: Access reflects current state immediately; recipients receive correction/retraction; old versions remain in authorized audit/history.

specTasks.title: Replace private URL copy
acceptanceCriteria: Tour, event, advance, map, and day-sheet sharing invoke the scoped share/publication service with no misleading Admin URL action.

specTasks.title: Define health/risk aggregation
acceptanceCriteria: Each signal has source, severity, threshold, owner, freshness, and remediation URL; unknown/dependency failure is not scored as healthy.

specTasks.title: Integrate route/logistics health
acceptanceCriteria: Conflicts, missing segments/rooms/seats/equipment/meals, and unresolved traveler data roll into summary.

specTasks.title: Create composable tour-book sections
acceptanceCriteria: Itinerary, contacts, travel, lodging, schedules, advance, maps, hospitality, equipment, tickets/credentials, and emergency info render through versioned section contracts.

specTasks.title: Add recipient-specific projections
acceptanceCriteria: A worker/vendor/public viewer receives only permitted sections/fields; snapshot manifest records projection version and test fixture proves no data leakage.

specTasks.title: Add mobile/offline package
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized content can be cached with encrypted/local policy, expiry, sync status, and revoked/superseded warning; sensitive content follows platform security constraints.

specTasks.title: Add section ownership/approvals
acceptanceCriteria: Route/stop changes can require owner/department approval; pending changes are visible and do not alter published operations prematurely.

specTasks.title: Add presence and conflict-safe collaboration
acceptanceCriteria: Active editor/presence is optional; version conflicts and comments resolve without data loss; notification noise is controlled.

specTasks.title: Unify Work Mode assignments
acceptanceCriteria: Publication creates/updates stable worker-facing assignment references rather than best-effort duplicates; role/shift changes reconcile deterministically.

specTasks.title: Add acknowledgement workflows
acceptanceCriteria: Publisher chooses required recipients/deadline; reminders/escalations are deduplicated; acknowledgement stores version and time.

specTasks.title: Add structured change notices
acceptanceCriteria: Post-publication change sets identify affected recipients/sections, show before/after in local context, require re-ack when policy says, and link remediation.

specTasks.title: Add emergency broadcast
acceptanceCriteria: Authorized high-priority notice supports bounded audience, multi-channel fanout, escalation, clear cancellation/correction, and abuse/audit controls.

specTasks.title: Integrate workforce/advance/live health
acceptanceCriteria: Coverage, credentials, labor/rest conflicts, overdue advance sections, unacknowledged day sheets, and incidents appear by stop and tour.

specTasks.title: Integrate commercial closeout
acceptanceCriteria: Ticketing, budget, contract, invoice, and settlement readiness controls complete/settled transitions.

specTasks.title: Add cancellation impact workflow
acceptanceCriteria: Cancellation previews notifications, reservations, vendor/contract obligations, ticket refunds, staff work, publications, and budget effects; follow-ups are assigned and tracked.

specTasks.title: Materialize/cache summary read model
acceptanceCriteria: Event-driven updates meet freshness SLO; fallback rebuild exists; cache keys include org, tour, access class, and version.

specTasks.title: Establish portfolio performance budget
acceptanceCriteria: Representative 500/5,000-tour organization tests meet agreed query, render, interaction, and bundle targets.

specTasks.title: Complete lifecycle E2E suite
acceptanceCriteria: Create through settled/archive passes for role variants, concurrent editors, failed dependencies, cancellation, and rollback scenarios.

specTasks.title: Retire legacy tour UI/API paths
acceptanceCriteria: Usage telemetry is zero, compatibility reads are reconciled, flags removed, policies/routes/code deleted, and migration report approved.

specTasks.title: Complete migration reconciliation
acceptanceCriteria: JSON, `tour_events`, and normalized plan match for all migrated tours; comparison job reports zero unexplained differences before old writes stop.

specTasks.title: Retire old planner components/write paths
acceptanceCriteria: Telemetry shows no use, feature flags removed, dead components deleted, and only canonical plan commands remain.

specTasks.title: Publication SLO dashboard
acceptanceCriteria: Measures queue age, success, provider latency/error, retry/dead-letter count, open/ack rate, stale offline clients, and unauthorized-token attempts.

specTasks.title: Failure-injection tests
acceptanceCriteria: Database/outbox/provider/offline failures cannot lose a publication, duplicate recipients, mark false success, or expose another audience's content.

specTasks.title: Token/security review
acceptanceCriteria: Tests cover enumeration, replay, referrer leakage, caching, brute force, passcode throttling, revocation, screenshot/download expectations, and child assets.

specTasks.title: Retire legacy Work Mode fanout
acceptanceCriteria: Comparison shows canonical assignments/deliveries complete; legacy inserts and status-only publish paths are removed.

workflows.title: Tour Planning, Stops, Assignment, and Publication

producer.outcome: Builds a tour, attaches canonical events, resolves readiness, and publishes.

recipients.outcome: Receives the assigned tour itinerary and changes.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Tour and event organization must match for every relationship; direct child-ID writes validate the parent chain.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: The Artist/crew itinerary matches the persisted canonical tour and event relationships.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

workflows.title: Artist Assignment and Artist-Surface Delivery

producer.outcome: Assigns an organization Artist to a tour or event.

recipients.outcome: Sees the assignment, event, and tour on Artist surfaces.

dataBoundaries.rlsExpectation: Roster relationships share one organization boundary and removal cannot delete the global Artist identity.

workflows.recipientVisibleResult: Assignment and removal round-trip across Admin and Artist surfaces.

recovery.retry: Retry is bounded, idempotent, and exposes the last failure.
recovery.reversal: A reviewed compensating or revocation command restores the prior safe state.
recovery.partialFailure: Partial effects remain visible and resumable; no silent success is returned.

references.canonicalSource: Authenticated acting-context and capability command wrappers
invariants: Organization and actor context come from trusted server state.
Every mutation declares capability, target, validation, idempotency, audit, and stable errors.

references.canonicalSource: events_v2, canonical tour access, and persisted plan/publication services
invariants: Legacy event identifiers are exposed only through the governed migration mapping.

references.canonicalSource: Shared Admin page header and explicit loading, empty, error, and permission states
invariants: Live Admin UI contains no mock or synthetic operational data.
Every surface provides accessible loading, empty, error, denied, success, and recovery behavior as applicable.

launchGates.title: Admin to Artist journey passes
launchGates.acceptance: Assignment and publication reach the intended Artist surface with tenant isolation.

launchGates.title: Canonical event lifecycle passes
launchGates.acceptance: Provider ingestion, events_v2, tour assignment, publication, calendar, and Artist delivery reconcile with zero unexplained delta.
